blocks.source: Canto XVI
blocks.translation: Canto XVI

blocks.source: Già era in loco onde s’udia ’l rimbombo
blocks.translation: Now was I where was heard the reverberation

blocks.source: de l’acqua che cadea ne l’altro giro,
blocks.translation: Of water falling into the next round,

blocks.source: simile a quel che l’arnie fanno rombo,
blocks.translation: Like to that humming which the beehives make,

blocks.source: quando tre ombre insieme si partiro,
blocks.translation: When shadows three together started forth,

blocks.source: correndo, d’una torma che passava
blocks.translation: Running, from out a company that passed

blocks.source: sotto la pioggia de l’aspro martiro.
blocks.translation: Beneath the rain of the sharp martyrdom.

blocks.source: Venian ver’ noi, e ciascuna gridava:
blocks.translation: Towards us came they, and each one cried out:

blocks.source: «Sòstati tu ch’a l’abito ne sembri
blocks.translation: “Stop, thou; for by thy garb to us thou seemest

blocks.source: esser alcun di nostra terra prava».
blocks.translation: To be some one of our depraved city.”

blocks.source: Ahimè, che piaghe vidi ne’ lor membri,
blocks.translation: Ah me! what wounds I saw upon their limbs,

blocks.source: ricenti e vecchie, da le fiamme incese!
blocks.translation: Recent and ancient by the flames burnt in!

blocks.source: Ancor men duol pur ch’i’ me ne rimembri.
blocks.translation: It pains me still but to remember it.

blocks.source: A le lor grida il mio dottor s’attese;
blocks.translation: Unto their cries my Teacher paused attentive;

blocks.source: volse ’l viso ver’ me, e «Or aspetta»,
blocks.translation: He turned his face towards me, and “Now wait,”

blocks.source: disse, «a costor si vuole esser cortese.
blocks.translation: He said; “to these we should be courteous.

blocks.source: E se non fosse il foco che saetta
blocks.translation: And if it were not for the fire that darts

blocks.source: la natura del loco, i’ dicerei
blocks.translation: From the nature of this place, I should say

blocks.source: che meglio stesse a te che a lor la fretta».
blocks.translation: That haste were more becoming thee than them.”

blocks.source: Ricominciar, come noi restammo, ei
blocks.translation: As soon as we stood still, they recommenced

blocks.source: l’antico verso; e quando a noi fuor giunti,
blocks.translation: The old refrain, and when they overtook us,

blocks.source: fenno una rota di sé tutti e trei.
blocks.translation: Formed of themselves a wheel, all three of them.

blocks.source: Qual sogliono i campion far nudi e unti,
blocks.translation: As champions stripped and oiled are wont to do,

blocks.source: avvisando lor presa e lor vantaggio,
blocks.translation: Watching for their advantage and their hold,

blocks.source: prima che sien tra lor battuti e punti,
blocks.translation: Before they come to blows and thrusts between them,

blocks.source: così rotando, ciascuno il visaggio
blocks.translation: Thus, wheeling round, did every one his visage

blocks.source: drizzava a me, sì che ’n contraro il collo
blocks.translation: Direct to me, so that in opposite wise

blocks.source: faceva ai piè continüo vïaggio.
blocks.translation: His neck and feet continual journey made.

blocks.source: E «Se miseria d’esto loco sollo
blocks.translation: And, “If the misery of this soft place

blocks.source: rende in dispetto noi e nostri prieghi»,
blocks.translation: Bring in disdain ourselves and our entreaties,”

blocks.source: cominciò l’uno, «e ’l tinto aspetto e brollo,
blocks.translation: Began one, “and our aspect black and blistered,

blocks.source: la fama nostra il tuo animo pieghi
blocks.translation: Let the renown of us thy mind incline

blocks.source: a dirne chi tu se’, che i vivi piedi
blocks.translation: To tell us who thou art, who thus securely

blocks.source: così sicuro per lo ’nferno freghi.
blocks.translation: Thy living feet dost move along through Hell.

blocks.source: Questi, l’orme di cui pestar mi vedi,
blocks.translation: He in whose footprints thou dost see me treading,

blocks.source: tutto che nudo e dipelato vada,
blocks.translation: Naked and skinless though he now may go,

blocks.source: fu di grado maggior che tu non credi:
blocks.translation: Was of a greater rank than thou dost think;

blocks.source: nepote fu de la buona Gualdrada;
blocks.translation: He was the grandson of the good Gualdrada;

blocks.source: Guido Guerra ebbe nome, e in sua vita
blocks.translation: His name was Guidoguerra, and in life

blocks.source: fece col senno assai e con la spada.
blocks.translation: Much did he with his wisdom and his sword.

blocks.source: L’altro, ch’appresso me la rena trita,
blocks.translation: The other, who close by me treads the sand,

blocks.source: è Tegghiaio Aldobrandi, la cui voce
blocks.translation: Is Tegghiaio Aldobrandi, whose voice

blocks.source: nel mondo sù dovria esser gradita.
blocks.translation: Above there in the world should welcome be.

blocks.source: E io, che posto son con loro in croce,
blocks.translation: And I, who with them on the cross am placed,

blocks.source: Iacopo Rusticucci fui, e certo
blocks.translation: Jacopo Rusticucci was; and truly

blocks.source: la fiera moglie più ch’altro mi nuoce».
blocks.translation: My savage wife, more than aught else, doth harm me.”

blocks.source: S’i’ fossi stato dal foco coperto,
blocks.translation: Could I have been protected from the fire,

blocks.source: gittato mi sarei tra lor di sotto,
blocks.translation: Below I should have thrown myself among them,

blocks.source: e credo che ’l dottor l’avria sofferto;
blocks.translation: And think the Teacher would have suffered it;

blocks.source: ma perch’ io mi sarei brusciato e cotto,
blocks.translation: But as I should have burned and baked myself,

blocks.source: vinse paura la mia buona voglia
blocks.translation: My terror overmastered my good will,

blocks.source: che di loro abbracciar mi facea ghiotto.
blocks.translation: Which made me greedy of embracing them.

blocks.source: Poi cominciai: «Non dispetto, ma doglia
blocks.translation: Then I began: “Sorrow and not disdain

blocks.source: la vostra condizion dentro mi fisse,
blocks.translation: Did your condition fix within me so,

blocks.source: tanta che tardi tutta si dispoglia,
blocks.translation: That tardily it wholly is stripped off,

blocks.source: tosto che questo mio segnor mi disse
blocks.translation: As soon as this my Lord said unto me

blocks.source: parole per le quali i’ mi pensai
blocks.translation: Words, on account of which I thought within me

blocks.source: che qual voi siete, tal gente venisse.
blocks.translation: That people such as you are were approaching.

blocks.source: Di vostra terra sono, e sempre mai
blocks.translation: I of your city am; and evermore

blocks.source: l’ovra di voi e li onorati nomi
blocks.translation: Your labours and your honourable names

blocks.source: con affezion ritrassi e ascoltai.
blocks.translation: I with affection have retraced and heard.

blocks.source: Lascio lo fele e vo per dolci pomi
blocks.translation: I leave the gall, and go for the sweet fruits

blocks.source: promessi a me per lo verace duca;
blocks.translation: Promised to me by the veracious Leader;

blocks.source: ma ’nfino al centro pria convien ch’i’ tomi».
blocks.translation: But to the centre first I needs must plunge.”

blocks.source: «Se lungamente l’anima conduca
blocks.translation: “So may the soul for a long while conduct

blocks.source: le membra tue», rispuose quelli ancora,
blocks.translation: Those limbs of thine,” did he make answer then,

blocks.source: «e se la fama tua dopo te luca,
blocks.translation: “And so may thy renown shine after thee,

blocks.source: cortesia e valor dì se dimora
blocks.translation: Valour and courtesy, say if they dwell

blocks.source: ne la nostra città sì come suole,
blocks.translation: Within our city, as they used to do,

blocks.source: o se del tutto se n’è gita fora;
blocks.translation: Or if they wholly have gone out of it;

blocks.source: ché Guiglielmo Borsiere, il qual si duole
blocks.translation: For Guglielmo Borsier, who is in torment

blocks.source: con noi per poco e va là coi compagni,
blocks.translation: With us of late, and goes there with his comrades,

blocks.source: assai ne cruccia con le sue parole».
blocks.translation: Doth greatly mortify us with his words.”

blocks.source: «La gente nuova e i sùbiti guadagni
blocks.translation: “The new inhabitants and the sudden gains,

blocks.source: orgoglio e dismisura han generata,
blocks.translation: Pride and extravagance have in thee engendered,

blocks.source: Fiorenza, in te, sì che tu già ten piagni».
blocks.translation: Florence, so that thou weep’st thereat already!”

blocks.source: Così gridai con la faccia levata;
blocks.translation: In this wise I exclaimed with face uplifted;

blocks.source: e i tre, che ciò inteser per risposta,
blocks.translation: And the three, taking that for my reply,

blocks.source: guardar l’un l’altro com’ al ver si guata.
blocks.translation: Looked at each other, as one looks at truth.

blocks.source: «Se l’altre volte sì poco ti costa»,
blocks.translation: “If other times so little it doth cost thee,”

blocks.source: rispuoser tutti, «il satisfare altrui,
blocks.translation: Replied they all, “to satisfy another,

blocks.source: felice te se sì parli a tua posta!
blocks.translation: Happy art thou, thus speaking at thy will!

blocks.source: Però, se campi d’esti luoghi bui
blocks.translation: Therefore, if thou escape from these dark places,

blocks.source: e torni a riveder le belle stelle,
blocks.translation: And come to rebehold the beauteous stars,

blocks.source: quando ti gioverà dicere “I’ fui”,
blocks.translation: When it shall pleasure thee to say, ‘I was,’

blocks.source: fa che di noi a la gente favelle».
blocks.translation: See that thou speak of us unto the people.”

blocks.source: Indi rupper la rota, e a fuggirsi
blocks.translation: Then they broke up the wheel, and in their flight

blocks.source: ali sembiar le gambe loro isnelle.
blocks.translation: It seemed as if their agile legs were wings.

blocks.source: Un amen non saria possuto dirsi
blocks.translation: Not an Amen could possibly be said

blocks.source: tosto così com’ e’ fuoro spariti;
blocks.translation: So rapidly as they had disappeared;

blocks.source: per ch’al maestro parve di partirsi.
blocks.translation: Wherefore the Master deemed best to depart.

blocks.source: Io lo seguiva, e poco eravam iti,
blocks.translation: I followed him, and little had we gone,

blocks.source: che ’l suon de l’acqua n’era sì vicino,
blocks.translation: Before the sound of water was so near us,

blocks.source: che per parlar saremmo a pena uditi.
blocks.translation: That speaking we should hardly have been heard.

blocks.source: Come quel fiume c’ha proprio cammino
blocks.translation: Even as that stream which holdeth its own course

blocks.source: prima dal Monte Viso ’nver’ levante,
blocks.translation: The first from Monte Veso tow’rds the East,

blocks.source: da la sinistra costa d’Apennino,
blocks.translation: Upon the left-hand slope of Apennine,

blocks.source: che si chiama Acquacheta suso, avante
blocks.translation: Which is above called Acquacheta, ere

blocks.source: che si divalli giù nel basso letto,
blocks.translation: It down descendeth into its low bed,

blocks.source: e a Forlì di quel nome è vacante,
blocks.translation: And at Forli is vacant of that name,

blocks.source: rimbomba là sovra San Benedetto
blocks.translation: Reverberates there above San Benedetto

blocks.source: de l’Alpe per cadere ad una scesa
blocks.translation: From Alps, by falling at a single leap,

blocks.source: ove dovea per mille esser recetto;
blocks.translation: Where for a thousand there were room enough;

blocks.source: così, giù d’una ripa discoscesa,
blocks.translation: Thus downward from a bank precipitate,

blocks.source: trovammo risonar quell’ acqua tinta,
blocks.translation: We found resounding that dark-tinted water,

blocks.source: sì che ’n poc’ ora avria l’orecchia offesa.
blocks.translation: So that it soon the ear would have offended.

blocks.source: Io avea una corda intorno cinta,
blocks.translation: I had a cord around about me girt,

blocks.source: e con essa pensai alcuna volta
blocks.translation: And therewithal I whilom had designed

blocks.source: prender la lonza a la pelle dipinta.
blocks.translation: To take the panther with the painted skin.

blocks.source: Poscia ch’io l’ebbi tutta da me sciolta,
blocks.translation: After I this had all from me unloosed,

blocks.source: sì come ’l duca m’avea comandato,
blocks.translation: As my Conductor had commanded me,

blocks.source: porsila a lui aggroppata e ravvolta.
blocks.translation: I reached it to him, gathered up and coiled,

blocks.source: Ond’ ei si volse inver’ lo destro lato,
blocks.translation: Whereat he turned himself to the right side,

blocks.source: e alquanto di lunge da la sponda
blocks.translation: And at a little distance from the verge,

blocks.source: la gittò giuso in quell’ alto burrato.
blocks.translation: He cast it down into that deep abyss.

blocks.source: ‘E’ pur convien che novità risponda’,
blocks.translation: “It must needs be some novelty respond,”

blocks.source: dicea fra me medesmo, ‘al novo cenno
blocks.translation: I said within myself, “to the new signal

blocks.source: che ’l maestro con l’occhio sì seconda’.
blocks.translation: The Master with his eye is following so.”

blocks.source: Ahi quanto cauti li uomini esser dienno
blocks.translation: Ah me! how very cautious men should be

blocks.source: presso a color che non veggion pur l’ovra,
blocks.translation: With those who not alone behold the act,

blocks.source: ma per entro i pensier miran col senno!
blocks.translation: But with their wisdom look into the thoughts!

blocks.source: El disse a me: «Tosto verrà di sovra
blocks.translation: He said to me: “Soon there will upward come

blocks.source: ciò ch’io attendo e che il tuo pensier sogna;
blocks.translation: What I await; and what thy thought is dreaming

blocks.source: tosto convien ch’al tuo viso si scovra».
blocks.translation: Must soon reveal itself unto thy sight.”

blocks.source: Sempre a quel ver c’ha faccia di menzogna
blocks.translation: Aye to that truth which has the face of falsehood,

blocks.source: de’ l’uom chiuder le labbra fin ch’el puote,
blocks.translation: A man should close his lips as far as may be,

blocks.source: però che sanza colpa fa vergogna;
blocks.translation: Because without his fault it causes shame;

blocks.source: ma qui tacer nol posso; e per le note
blocks.translation: But here I cannot; and, Reader, by the notes

blocks.source: di questa comedìa, lettor, ti giuro,
blocks.translation: Of this my Comedy to thee I swear,

blocks.source: s’elle non sien di lunga grazia vòte,
blocks.translation: So may they not be void of lasting favour,

blocks.source: ch’i’ vidi per quell’ aere grosso e scuro
blocks.translation: Athwart that dense and darksome atmosphere

blocks.source: venir notando una figura in suso,
blocks.translation: I saw a figure swimming upward come,

blocks.source: maravigliosa ad ogne cor sicuro,
blocks.translation: Marvellous unto every steadfast heart,

blocks.source: sì come torna colui che va giuso
blocks.translation: Even as he returns who goeth down

blocks.source: talora a solver l’àncora ch’aggrappa
blocks.translation: Sometimes to clear an anchor, which has grappled

blocks.source: o scoglio o altro che nel mare è chiuso,
blocks.translation: Reef, or aught else that in the sea is hidden,

blocks.source: che ’n sù si stende e da piè si rattrappa.
blocks.translation: Who upward stretches, and draws in his feet.
